description: An interactive Retirement Planner: their pension pot year by year to 100, in today's money, with sliders for the age they retire, what they pay in a month and what they spend a year, and the State Pension from their State Pension age. Starts from their own pensions and Retirement overview figures, with labelled examples for anything missing. Use for 'can I retire at 60', 'will my pension last', 'what if I paid in more'. In an assistant that shows apps it answers with the tool itself; the text says the same.

annualSpending.description: Spending a year in retirement, today's money. In pounds. Leave out to start from their own figures in Foliopeak.

monthlyContribution.description: Paid into pensions a month until then. In pounds. Leave out to start from their own figures in Foliopeak.

retireAge.description: The age they'd retire at, if the question gives one.

name: get_retirement_planner
title: Retirement Planner
